message:
fix(log-upload): nothing in the product ever stopped the worker

log_upload_stop() had zero callers in the product -- only log_upload_test.cpp,
nine times, which is why the gap kept looking covered. At exit the function-local
static holding the worker was destroyed with the std::thread still joinable, and
that is std::terminate() by definition. The host also ran WSACleanup() while the
worker was inside a socket call.

Not detach: the worker touches the static state and the caller's callback, so
detaching turns a terminate into a use-after-free and lost log lines. It has to
be joined.

- LogUploadShutdown, an RAII guard, declared in both entry points.
- log_upload_shutdown(): latch, stop, then drop the auth callback once joined.
  The latch is read under the same lock that starts the worker, so a sign-in
  racing the close cannot slip a second thread past the join.
- WSACleanup and the GDI cleanup became scope guards, because a line at the end
  of a function runs BEFORE the destructors -- the join has to come first.
- The final drain stops starting new requests after 3 s. Without a bound the wait
  is queue depth times the http timeout, on the UI thread.

Bound measured, not assumed: 3 s + one in-flight http_post = 5,997 ms against a
server that accepts and never answers.

Regression is a new suite of isolated child processes, judged on exit code,
because a test calling stop() itself proves nothing about what ships. Negative
control: the same work without the guard exits 3. It also reads the two entry
points from source and checks the guard is declared -- exactly the link that was
missing.

This is an independently correct fix. It is NOT claimed as the cause of the field
BEX64/c0000409: there is no PDB for that build, so the offsets are unresolved and
other terminate paths are not ruled out.

Also adds the regression the verifier asked for: a health route that fails, and
one that answers saying nothing, must leave the http path exactly as it was. That
pair binds the fixture's observe port to httpPort+1 -- the layout every deployed
http directory has -- and asserts the opposite of the cached-token cases above it,
which use an ephemeral port. One proves the advertisement was used; this one
proves it is not required. directory_retry_test 57 -> 67.
